children.name: settings-migration-text
children.value: Saved settings were migrated from a previous version of FlightGear. If you encounter any problems when using the system, try restoring the default settings, before reporting a problem. Saved settings can affect the appearance, performance and features of the simulator.

children.name: comment
children.value: Title of the error message/popup window

children.name: comment
children.value: Added to error message popup notification to prompt user how to get more info

children.name: error-next-steps
children.value: This dialog is work-in-progress. The information shown may not be fully correct, so please check the detailed information (below) and give feedback if something seems wrong.

children.name: error-category-aircraft
children.value: This aircraft (%VALUE%) contains errors. This may include visual issues, or the aircraft might not fly at all. Check for an updated version of the aircraft from its developers.

children.name: error-category-aircraft-from-hangar
children.value: The selected aircraft (%VALUE%) contains errors. This may cause visual issues, or the aircraft might not fly at all. Please report the information below to the aircraft hangar's maintainers.

children.name: error-category-custom-scenery
children.value: The custom scenery at '%VALUE%' contains errors. Parts may be missing, or the scenery may not load at all. Check for an updated version of the scenery.

children.name: error-category-terrasync
children.value: Scenery downloaded via TerraSync is not loading correctly. This usually indicates a problem with your network connection or local disk.

children.name: error-category-addon
children.value: The add-on '%VALUE%' contains errors. Please report this to the add-on developers.

children.name: error-category-scenario
children.value: The scenario '%VALUE%' contains errors, and may not work correctly.

children.name: error-category-input-device
children.value: The joystick (input device) '%VALUE%' couldn't be loaded correctly. This usually means its configuration file is incorrect.

children.name: error-category-fgdata
children.value: Errors were found loading the core simulator files (FGData). This usually indicates a problem with the installation, or your local disk.

children.name: error-category-unknown
children.value: Errors occurred in an unknown part of FlightGear. Please report this bug to the FlightGear development team.

children.name: error-category-traffic
children.value: Problems occurred loading simulated aircraft traffic: some traffic may not appear.

children.name: error-category-out-of-memory
children.value: Allocating memory failed. Some resources will not be loaded. Adjust your settings to reduce view distance or number of objects loaded.

children.name: error-category-multiplayer
children.value: Loading a model for another pilot (via multi-player) failed. The other pilot will appear as a default model. (You can disable these errors from the multiplayer settings dialog.)

children.name: error-category-shaders
children.value: Problems occurred loading visual effects (shaders). This can cause objects to be invisible or appear incorrect. It can sometimes be fixed by changing rendering settings inside FlightGear, or occasionally, by updating the drivers for your graphics card.

children.name: error-category-shared-models
children.value: The shared models data is missing or incomplete. This means all scenery will be missing some 3D models. To fix this, please enable TerraSync or download the current shared models data from https://www.flightgear.org/scenery/shared-models

children.name: error-category-network
children.value: Network errors occurred while downloading data. Check your network connection is working correctly.

children.name: error-type-not-found
children.value: The file or resource was not found

children.name: error-type-bad-header
children.value: File or resource header is incorrect

children.name: error-type-bad-data
children.value: File or resource is invalid or corrupted

children.name: error-type-misconfigured
children.value: The resource contains a configuration problem

children.name: error-type-io
children.value: Unable to read/write files correctly (check permissions and disk space)

children.name: error-aircraft-systems
children.value: Errors occured loading aircraft systems (fuel, electrical, hydrualics)

children.name: shared-models-missing-terrasync
children.value: The shared scenery models have not downloaded correctly. This will cause missing elements in all scenery. Automatic scenery downloading is enabled, check your network connection is working as expected.

children.name: shared-models-missing
children.value: The shared scenery models are not installed correctly. This will cause missing elements in all scenery. Enable automatic scenery downloading, or download the shared models from https://www.flightgear.org/scenery/shared-models and add them to your scenery list.

children.name: live-data-desc
children.value: Fetch live weather data for your nearest airport from noaa.gov. You need a working internet connection. Weather is generated automatically, once a valid METAR is received.

children.name: manual-input-desc
children.value: Enter your favorite METAR weather. A valid METAR syntax is required.

children.name: isa-desc
children.value: A standard atmosphere model for testing and calibrating aircraft performance and design.

children.name: core-high-pressure-region-desc
children.value: The center of a high pressure region, characterized by descending air and hence only weak cloud development with high visibility.

children.name: high-pressure-region-desc
children.value: A high pressure region, characterized by moderate to strong Cumulus development in the afternoon and fairly good visibility conditions.

children.name: border-high-pressure-region-name
children.value: Border of a high pressure region

children.name: border-high-pressure-region-desc
children.value: The border of a high pressure region, in which the airmass becomes unstable and various convective and stratiform clouds may appear.

children.name: border-low-pressure-region-name
children.value: Border of a low pressure region

children.name: border-low-pressure-region-desc
children.value: The border of a low pressure region, in which the airmass is unstable and convective clouds start to form layers and merge into stratiform clouds.

children.name: low-pressure-region-desc
children.value: A low pressure region, characterized by rising air, widespread formation of stratiform clouds and beginning rain.

children.name: core-low-pressure-region-desc
children.value: The core of a low pressure region, characterized by overcast clouds, bad visibility on the ground and significant rainfall.

children.name: warm-sector-desc
children.value: A warm sector, characterized by high moisture in the air and haze extending up to high altitudes, but otherwise largely convective cloud development.

children.name: fair-weather-desc
children.value: A lovely day for trip to your favorite 100$ hamburger airfield

children.name: thunderstorm-desc
children.value: A hot and damp summer day with thunderstorms developing in the afternoon. Be prepared for reduction of visibility in showers and strong gusts near thunderstorms

children.name: stormy-monday-desc
children.value: You're out for an adventure? Gusty winds blowing from the west and isolated thunderstorms should be avoided. Fasten your seatbelt!

children.name: marginal-vfr-desc
children.value: After the storm - limited visibility and some showers. Go or No-Go?

children.name: cat-one-minimum-desc
children.value: If you just got your IFR rating, this is what you are allowed to do. But can you?

children.name: cat-two-minimum-desc
children.value: With just a 1/4 mile visibility and clouds at 100ft, you don't see much of the runway until seconds before touchdown. Trust your instruments to stay alive.

children.name: cat-three-b-minimum-desc
children.value: This is expert level. You will barely see the taxiway from the cockpit, even if you are on ground. Fog and light drizzle, freezing level at 1000ft.

children.name: early-morning-fog-desc
children.value: Fog developed this autumn's morning. Expect good visibility above the layer. However - getting through it can be a challenge. Stay alive for a 500' climb and you'll see the sun!
